scope: Exact source enrollment/reservation functions with actual SQL, canonical signed schedules, invoices, ledger and separately committed PDO payoff writers. Only gateway settings, transport and readback are synthetic namespace boundaries. No HTTP or real payment claim.
preserved_fixture_failure: The first expanded parent run passed a nullable client argument to the older preflight signature and stopped at 115 assertions. The fixture now calls each actual caller preflight and injects the committed writer when that caller builds its contract; the direct reservation case explicitly preflights. The corrected parent run completes all 240 assertions. Original outputs remain retained.
